texts.zh:
为了加快我们通向纯净的道路并识别基因组异常者，我们推行了定期基因检测，拥有'高质量'DNA已成为一种炫耀资本。

据称某些帝国官员一直在谎报他们的生物特征，伪造检测结果以表明他们拥有比实际更理想的特质。如果这件事曝光，这种对真相的隐瞒必将激起公众的愤怒。
texts.en:
Having rolled out regular genetic testing to streamline our path toward purity, and identify genomic outliers, 'high quality' DNA has become something to boast about.

Certain empire officials have supposedly been lying about their biological makeup, forging test results that suggest they have more desirable traits than they do in reality. If it comes to light, this concealment of truth threatens to outrage the public.

label.zh: 我们需要更准确可靠的检测。
label.en: We need more accurate and reliable testing.

label.zh: 也许这位官员只是犯了个错误...
label.en: Perhaps this official made a mistake...
